tasks.title: Tests for the App.Core editor kernel
acceptance: 1. Tests live in `src/DungeonMaster.Tests`, which targets `net10.0` and already references `DungeonMaster.App.Core` (`DungeonMaster.Tests.csproj`, ProjectReference to `..\DungeonMaster.App.Core\DungeonMaster.App.Core.csproj`). DO NOT add tests to `src/DungeonMaster.App.Tests`: it runs outside a MAUI host, and whether that is fixable is Session 6's question. Do not add any ProjectReference to any project; this task owns no `.csproj` and no `packages.lock.json`.

2. `AreaOutlineGeometryTests` covers `Translate`: a delta offsets `End`, `Ctrl1` and `Ctrl2` of every segment; a segment whose `Ctrl1` or `Ctrl2` is null keeps it null; an empty outline returns an empty list; a zero delta returns an equal-valued outline; a null outline and a null element each throw `ArgumentNullException`.

3. `AreaOutlineGeometryTests` covers `ToPolygon`'s vertex ORDER and the dropped duplicate: for a known closed outline, assert the produced vertex sequence element by element, and assert the count equals the segment count (not segment count + 1). A test that asserts only the count would pass against a wrongly ordered polygon and does not satisfy this criterion.

4. `AreaOutlineGeometryTests` covers `ContainsPoint` with a point inside, a point outside, and a polygon of fewer than three vertices returning false; and `Area` with a square of known area asserted in both winding orders, both returning the same positive value.

5. `MapHitTesterTests` pins the AREA tie-break: two overlapping areas whose polygons contain the point and whose polygon areas differ resolve to the smaller; two whose polygon areas are EQUAL resolve to the one earlier in the input list. It also covers an area with an empty `Outline` being skipped, and no containing area returning null.

6. `MapHitTesterTests` pins the drag preview: an area whose `Id` equals `dragPreviewAreaId` is hit-tested at its TRANSLATED position, proven by a point that hits only after the delta is applied and misses before it. An area whose id does not match is not translated.

7. `MapHitTesterTests` pins the OBJECT hit test: containment is inclusive on all four edges (a point exactly on an edge hits), `Position` is treated as the bounding-box CENTRE, the tie-break ranks on the unscaled `wTiles * hTiles` from the supplied `objectSize` delegate, and an object with a large `Scale` does NOT beat a smaller-tile object — because `Scale` is deliberately not consulted.

8. `src/DungeonMaster.Tests/AppCore/Editor/MapEditorStateTests.cs` pins the tool transition: switching to `Draw` sets `DrawState` to `Drawing` when the drawing session is active and `DrawingReady` when it is not; switching to any other tool while `DrawState` is `Drawing` returns `ToolChange.AbortInProgressDraw == true` and leaves `DrawState == Idle`; switching to another tool while `DrawState` is NOT `Drawing` returns `AbortInProgressDraw == false`. `ClearHoveredArea` is true for exactly Draw, Pan and Place, and false for Move, Select and Erase. `LeavingPlaceTool` is true for every tool except `Place`.

9. `MapEditorStateTests` pins `ConfirmObjectDragIfPastThreshold` at the boundary: with no pending press it returns false; at a distance of exactly `MapEditorState.ObjectDragThreshold` from the anchor it returns false; at a distance just above it, it returns true and `IsObjectDragConfirmed` becomes true; a further call after confirmation still returns true. Use `MapEditorState.ObjectDragThreshold` in the test rather than the literal 6f, so the test moves with the constant.

10. `MapEditorStateTests` pins `ResetDrawState`: with a floor selected `DrawState` becomes `DrawingReady`, without one it becomes `Idle`; `IsMoveDragging` becomes false and `DraggingAreaId` and `MoveGrabTile` become null; and object-interaction state (`SelectedObjectId`, `HoveredObjectId`, `PendingObjectClickId`) is NOT cleared by it, since only `ClearObjectInteraction` and `SetActiveTool` do that.
11. Every test name states its condition and its expected outcome. No test is named with `Works`, `IsCorrect` or an equivalent, and no name claims more than its assertions check.

12. EVERY test in this task is SHOWN ABLE TO FAIL, and the report says how for each group. Because the implementation already exists when this task runs, use demonstrated discrimination: inject the specific defect the test exists to catch (for example, flip `HitTestArea`'s tie-break to `<=`; drop the duplicate-vertex removal in `ToPolygon`; move the `DrawState` read in `SetActiveTool` to after the `Idle` assignment; change the threshold comparison to `>=`), name the command you ran, and report the failure it produced. Revert every injected defect afterwards and prove the revert with a clean `git diff` over `src/DungeonMaster.App.Core/`. "Verified by inspection" does not satisfy this criterion.
13. Tests are deterministic and isolated: no wall clock, no sleeping, no shared mutable state, no reliance on execution order. Any randomness is seeded and the seed is reported on failure.

14. Every new file is TAB-indented, CRLF-terminated, UTF-8 with no byte-order mark, and ends with a newline; verify with `grep -c "^\t" <file>` (non-zero) and `grep -c "^    " <file>` (zero) on each, and report both numbers.

15. `dotnet build C:\Users\dmarq\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Users-dmarq-Development-Repos-dungeon-master\c737bdff-1235-4a6f-bbb6-1f0c1d9b7376\scratchpad\worktrees\dir-2026-08-27-give-the-editor-a-seam\src\DungeonMaster.sln` reports `0 Warning(s)` and `0 Error(s)`; quote both lines.

16. `dotnet test` on that same solution path reports zero failures, and `DungeonMaster.Tests` (net10.0) passes STRICTLY MORE than the 506 it passed at `d33ec23`. Report the two per-assembly lines separately and state the delta you added; do not state a combined figure.

17. `MapEditorStateTests` also covers the three transition members no other criterion here reaches, so that every operation the contract declares has a test that would fail if it were unmet: `BeginMoveDrag` sets `IsMoveDragging`, `DraggingAreaId` and `MoveGrabTile` together; `EndMoveDrag` clears all three and is a no-op rather than a throw when no drag is in progress; and `ClearObjectInteraction` nulls `SelectedObjectId`, `HoveredObjectId`, `PendingObjectClickId`, `ObjectDragAnchorScreen`, `ObjectDragTargetCanvas` and `PopupBounds` and sets `IsObjectDragConfirmed` and `ObjectLongPressHandled` to false — asserted member by member, not by a single flag.
